ruling.explanation:
The cancellation fee of SGD 6.00 was correctly charged, and the driver is entitled to 80% of it. Both parties' accounts and the platform telemetry point the same way.

FOR THE DRIVER — POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver about 24 m from the Door 5 pin, far inside the 150 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for the AIRPORT zone class, and the first in-geofence fix at 22:40:00 precedes the arrival event. (c) The single continuous in-geofence run measures 500 seconds (22:40:00 to 22:48:20) against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum — a 20-second surplus, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) The trip ended cancelled by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 22:48:20, with no boarding event (started_at and ended_at are null), and that code is one of the three limb (d) accepts. None of POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. This is not a wrong-entrance case (POL-NS-03), because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-05 does not bite: the arrival marker matches the nearest fix within 20 seconds, far under the 90-second skew threshold, and the driver was stationary at 0.0 kph about 24 m from the pin, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 kph trigger fires, and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not bite because there is no shortfall, so its accumulation rule is not needed. EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, which makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable — but nothing turns on that, because the dwell clears the minimum on its own.

FOR THE RIDER — POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. Limb (b) fails: the driver replied 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' 18 seconds after your 22:41:40 message, inside the 120-second window, so the clause does not apply whatever the reply said. Limb (c) also fails: 0 of your 24 recorded fixes fall inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius; each sits about 519 m from the pin.

Your request for escalation under POL-NS-09 is declined. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence. The chat log has you saying you were walking over, and the rider track shows your device still about 519 m from the pin; both agree you were not at the pickup point during the waiting window — the chat does not assert you had arrived, so the two do not conflict on presence. The policy's own rider-position test (POL-NS-04 limb (c)) answers where you were. No other POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; your no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both counterparty-dispute counters are 0; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, both under the thresholds of 4 and 0.08); and no deciding fact rests solely on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d). The two endpoints you ask to have verified are carried by a 100%-coverage trace with no sampling gaps and a consistent 10-second cadence, so the 20-second margin is real and the case does not need a reviewer.

WEIGHT AND AMOUNT — No artifact is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat defect (4 messages recorded, 4 in the log, no missing msg_ids), and the fare reconciles. The deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0 — EV-GPS-09102, EV-TRIP-09102 and EV-CHAT-09102 — so nothing caps confidence below the evidence weight; the driver's counterparty statement is consistent with the chat log but carries no weight multiplier and does not affect the cap. The SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the fee schedule: it is the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00). POL-NS-07 therefore pays the driver 80% of SGD 6.00, i.e. SGD 4.80, with SGD 1.20 retained as the platform service fee. Your charge stands; this ruling moves SGD 4.80 to the driver. No context-only profile field (rating, account age, lifetime counters such as prior_no_show_flags) has been used as a ground of decision, and no referral is produced by any clause.
